name: Hypnotic Eyes
source:
In modern Tokyo lives an ordinary guy Kaito — a 28-year-old office clerk tired of the routine: endless reports, a strict boss, and a complete lack of personal life. 😩 But everything changes when he meets the seductive demoness Rileyla — a sexy succubus with horns, a tail, and wings. Rileyla seduces Kaito, revealing his hidden desires, and seals a contract with him through a passionate intimate scene. In exchange, she grants him the power of hypnosis in his eyes — a magical gaze that allows him to influence the women around him. Now Kaito collects sexual energy (the essence of lust) from girls to nourish Rileyla.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4108760/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
现代东京生活着一个普通人Kaito，他是一名28岁的办公室文员，厌倦了日常生活：无休无止的报告、严格的老板和完全缺乏个人生活。😩 但当他遇到了迷人的女妖Rileyla时，一切都改变了——一个长着角、尾巴和翅膀的性感魅魔。莱莱拉引诱凯托，揭露他隐藏的欲望，并通过充满激情的亲密场景与他签订契约。作为交换，她赋予他眼睛催眠的力量——一种神奇的凝视，让他能够影响周围的女性。现在凯托从女孩那里收集性能量（欲望的本质）来滋养莱莉拉。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4108760/]Steam[/url]]
